verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs explicitly describe built-in Search Analytics showing popular searches, no-results queries, and click-through rates, plus comparison mode and CSV/XLSX export, directly matching the story; community evidence corroborates that Algolia's analytics let users tie queries to business outcomes without deep engineering effort. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the no-results/click-through dashboard specifically (only vendor docs and a general community endorsement are available).
